dogecoin.text:
I’m really not trying to sound like a shill, but the four day chart for $CHOW is crazy.

Crazy in a good way.

Of course, meme-coins are doing well right now (e.g.: $SHIB, $DOGE, #ELON, etc...), so there are many opportunities to ride the bull.

But - Damn - CHOW...  Thank you. https://t.co/UmHNWHMvLt

Back in February, when $CHOW first launched, I posted on Twitter:

“This coin will either do a 10x or crash to zero.”

Since that post, CHOW has done more than 20x.

And with the pattern set by dog-centric meme coins like $DOGE and $SHIB, we might - MIGHT – see another 20x. https://t.co/1lfZtvLshI
